subject: Turnover cleaning for our portfolio
body:
Hi there,

My name is Dana Whitfield and I'm with Harbor Point Property Management. We manage 64 units across three apartment complexes in Port Charlotte and our current turnover cleaning vendor just dropped us. We have 6 move-outs this month and need someone ASAP. Can you also handle make-ready repairs (drywall patches, minor plumbing)?

You can reach me at 941-555-0182.

Thanks,
Dana

subject: Website contact form
body: I own a single family rental home in North Port. Tenant is moving out end of next month. Looking for a quote on move-out cleaning. No rush, just getting prices.

subject: Landscaping bid request
body:
Good morning,

The Sunset Palms HOA board is accepting bids for landscaping and irrigation maintenance of our common areas for next year. The community has 120 homes. Please send a proposal by Nov 15.

Regards,
Patricia Gomez
Board Secretary
(239) 555-0147

subject: URGENT roaches
body:
we have a roach problem in two of our duplex units and tenants are threatening to withhold rent. need pest control this week. call me 941.555.0133

- Tariq

subject: Website contact form
body: Hello, I work for Coastal Ridge Investments. We're acquiring a 40-unit apartment building in December and want a full inspection plus ongoing maintenance and turnover cleaning once we close. Who should I talk to about a contract?

subject: Office building - HVAC and general maintenance
body:
Hi,

This is Sam Patel from Bayside Commercial Group. We have a two-story office building in Venice and the AC unit on the second floor has been failing. We'd also like a quote on a monthly maintenance plan. Please call 941-555-0119 when you can.

Best,
Sam

subject: Website contact form
body: I have three rental homes and I'm getting tired of chasing handymen. Do you do maintenance and lawn care as a package? Budgeting for next year.

subject: Move-in inspections
body:
Hello,

We manage 18 condos for out-of-state owners and need someone to do move-in and move-out condition reports with photos. Is that something you offer? What's the turnaround?

Thank you,
Greg Holloway
Gulf Breeze Rentals

subject: Leak!!
body: Hi, I'm Lauren. Water is leaking from the ceiling in my rental condo, tenant just called me. I'm out of town. Can someone go out today? 239-555-0164

subject: Website contact form
body: Just curious what you charge. I manage a 12 unit apartment complex, might want cleaning between tenants down the road.

Nina Okafor

subject: Townhome yard
body:
